acme_infra: hey team — our service started getting 400s from /v1/rerank about 2m ago. example response: `{"error":"missing required field: items"}`. i'm attaching the payload we're sending
acme_infra: ```
POST /v1/rerank
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer XXX

{
  \"requestId\": \"abc-123\",
  \"topK\": 3,
  \"Items\": {
    \"candidateList\": [
      {\"id\": \"c1\", \"text\": null, \"score\": \"0.5\"},
      {\"id\": \"c2\", \"text\": \"\", \"score\": \"0.3\"}
    ]
  }
}
```
acme_infra: note we upgraded our client lib yesterday, might be related.
deploy-bot: @jamal_s new support ticket created: #TCK-4821 (auto) :white_check_mark:
jamal_s: thanks — pinging in. quick glance: two likely issues: (1) key casing — API expects `items` (array) not `Items` object, (2) candidate `text` should be non-empty string and `score` should be numeric, not string.
irene_support: can you repro locally? try this minimal curl to confirm server behaves same:```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -d '{"items":[{"id":"c1","text":"hello","score":0.5}],"topK":3}'
```
acme_infra: running now... getting 200 with that payload. ok that matches.
jamal_s: great — so root cause is client serialization. two action items: (A) send `items` as an array, (B) ensure each candidate has `text` non-empty and `score` numeric. also avoid nesting under random keys like `candidateList`.
irene_support: leaving a small repro snippet the devs can use in JS:```
// wrong way (what we saw)
const body = { Items: { candidateList: candidates } }
// correct
const body = { items: candidates.map(c => ({ id: c.id, text: c.text || '', score: Number(c.score) })) }
```
acme_infra: thanks — we found the bug in our serializer: it maps to `Items` when running older browser polyfill. patching now.
acme_infra: deployed fix, sending a test -> 200 and ranked indices returned as expected.
jamal_s: awesome, closing the loop: marking root cause as client-side keycase + null/empty text + string scores. leaving notes in ticket for SDK teams to add stricter validation and a regression test.
irene_support: adding a KB snippet to /support/docs:rerank-validation with example bad/good payloads and the exact 400 message text.
acme_infra: thanks everyone :pray: saved our morning.
jamal_s: np — reopen if you see anything else. :thumbsup:
